# MODRACX — Kenneth D'Silva

> Kenneth D'Silva is a full-stack web developer, technology strategist, and certified e-commerce architect specializing in Magento 2, Shopify Plus, custom web applications, ERP/IMS systems, technical SEO, cybersecurity, and DevOps infrastructure.

Kenneth D'Silva (brand: MODRACX) operates as an independent consultant, solution architect, and lead engineer delivering resilient, high-performance digital commerce platforms for global brands.
